title: NEMAR iEEG geometry report, version 1
description: What one run of the iEEG geometry pipeline over a dataset decided, per electrodes file and per track (labels, freesurfer, spm, surfaces), and what an apply would add, change or remove. Deterministic for the same dataset commit and pipeline version: no timestamps, no absolute paths. A status of written means the run writes (dry run) or wrote (apply) the listed outputs; unchanged means the outputs already exist byte for byte; kept means an owned file was edited by hand or sits where this would write and is left alone; needs-human and refused are never written; skipped means the track does not apply or the file was not fetched.

suppressions.description: Dataset-level reasons that stopped blind label trials, with the electrodes files they affect.

changes.description: Work-tree paths (relative to the dataset) an apply adds, changes or removes, and owned paths it leaves as they are (kept).

surface_entries.description: The entries of geometry/index.json (schema nemar-ieeg-geometry-index, version 1), one per electrodes file with a drawable subject surface.

evidence.description: Evidence grade of the written positions or surface fit (specific or plausible), null when nothing was written.

numbers.description: The key numbers of the decision (distances in millimeters, counts, fractions); keys depend on the track and are additive, so a reader ignores keys it does not know. labels (written): label_rule (on-vertex-1.0mm, ecog-2.0mm or depth-plausible, the rule that graded the evidence), median_mm, p90_mm, n_used, and shift_control_min_median_mm (the smallest median over six 10 mm axis shifts, reported not judged; on-vertex rule only). freesurfer (written): frame_fit_median_mm, fit_rule (ecog-2.0mm), n_placed, left_out, pial_distance_median_mm, and the registration check numbers registration_side_fraction, registration_centroid_mm, registration_extent_error (largest per-axis relative difference) and registration_affine_residual_mm (the four registration numbers are also present on a refusal after the registration check ran, as with registration-check-failed). spm: inversion_residual_median_mm, the field check numbers field_check_median_mm, field_check_p10_mm, field_check_centroid_mm and field_check_extent_deviation (also present on refusals that ran the check), inside_fraction, and depth_contact_median_mm (the depth contacts against the template shell, reported not judged). surfaces: median_mm, frame_choice, contact_type (the type of the fitted contacts) and fit_rule (ecog-2.0mm or depth, the rule applied).
